Evaluate the conditional expression and
return one of the two input values based on
the results of the expression.
The AMPS expression engine can
conditionally evaluate the terms provided to
the IF statement in version 5.3.4 and
greater.
In previous versions of AMPS, all
expressions provided to the IF statement
were fully evaluated before the IF
statement was evaluated.
